verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents API access to linked-account balances, ownership and transaction data for integrators. It never describes a user-facing bulk export of the user's own data in open formats, or any offboarding or portability path. API access to bank data is the product's core data-aggregation function, a developer building block rather than a documented data-export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
